title: FlowLeaf 66
tagline: 66 days to make building with AI a habit — and a portfolio to prove it.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: Ship a page on day 2, learn to direct a coding agent, call APIs and AI models, deploy a backend, pick your track and solve one real person's problem.

phases.title: Build
phases.goal: Master the core craft of your track: full-stack AI apps and bots, or code-made video from single frames to your own one-command pipeline.

phases.title: Ship
phases.goal: Work with real users and real clients: launch, listen, iterate, run agents in parallel, automate — and start your capstone.

phases.title: Portfolio & Earn
phases.goal: Launch your capstone in public, build a portfolio that sells, send your first pitches and leave with a plan for the next 66 days.
